title: AI Engineer
description:
Data \& AI Engineer0\.5 \- 2 yearsSBC Office, Pune (PNQ02\), Teerth techno space office, Pune (PNQ01\)Full\-TimeAbout ComprinnoComprinno is a NASSCOM\-incubated company headquartered in Bangalore, with offices in Pune, Coimbatore, and the United States. We specialize in cloud transformation, DevOps, infrastructure automation, and Artificial Intelligence, enabling organizations to build scalable, secure, and high\-performing cloud environments on AWS.Our flagship SaaS platform, **Tevico**, offers intelligent cloud governance and observability for AWS workloads. It helps enterprises improve uptime, reduce costs, and ensure compliance by proactively detecting anomalies and triggering automated remediation workflows.As an AWS Advanced Consulting Partner, Comprinno helps organizations migrate, modernize, secure, and operate cloud environments while adopting emerging technologies such as Generative AI and Agentic AI.About the RoleWe are seeking a motivated and technically strong **Data \& AI Engineer** to contribute to data\-driven and AI\-powered solutions for enterprise customers and internal platforms.In this role, you will work across data engineering, machine learning, Generative AI, and cloud\-native analytics solutions while collaborating with architects, senior engineers, and customer teams. You will gain hands\-on experience building production\-grade data pipelines, AI applications, and cloud\-native analytics solutions using AWS technologies.This role is ideal for professionals who want to build a career in Data Engineering, Machine Learning, Applied AI, MLOps, and Generative AI.Key ResponsibilitiesData Engineering \& Analytics

* Assist in building and maintaining data pipelines for customer and internal projects.
* Perform data preparation, cleansing, transformation, and feature engineering activities.
* Work with structured and unstructured datasets from multiple sources.
* Support development of scalable data processing workflows and analytics solutions.
* Ensure data quality, reliability, and consistency across projects.

Machine Learning \& Applied AI

* Support development, training, testing, and deployment of machine learning models.
* Participate in model evaluation, experimentation, and optimization activities.
* Work on use cases involving:
* Predictive Analytics
* Classification
* Forecasting
* Recommendation Systems
* Natural Language Processing (NLP)
* Assist in integrating AI and ML solutions into production environments.

Generative AI \& Prompt Engineering

* Experiment with Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI frameworks.
* Assist in building AI assistants, RAG applications, and GenAI\-powered workflows.
* Design, test, and optimize prompts for business use cases.
* Evaluate model outputs and improve response quality through prompt engineering techniques.
* Explore emerging AI tools, frameworks, and orchestration platforms.

AWS Data \& AI Services

* Work with AWS services such as:
* Amazon SageMaker
* Amazon Bedrock
* AWS Glue
* Amazon Athena
* Amazon Redshift
* Amazon OpenSearch
* AWS Lambda
* Amazon S3
* Assist in deploying and managing data and AI workloads on AWS.

Collaboration \& Innovation

* Collaborate with CloudOps, DevOps, Product, and Architecture teams.
* Participate in customer projects and solution implementation activities.
* Document workflows, experiments, and technical approaches.
* Research new technologies and contribute ideas to innovation initiatives.
* Contribute to reusable assets, templates, and accelerators within the Data \& AI practice.

Required Qualifications \& Skills

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in (B.E./B.Tech./M.E./M.Tech.):
* Computer Science
* Data Science
* Artificial Intelligence
* Machine Learning
* Statistics
* Mathematics
* Related technical disciplines
* 0–2 years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Data Engineering, Applied AI, or related fields.
* Strong programming skills in Python.
* Familiarity with:
* Pandas
* NumPy
* Scikit\-Learn
* TensorFlow or PyTorch
* Good understanding of:
* Data Structures
* Algorithms
* Statistics
* Machine Learning Fundamentals
* Software Engineering Principles
* Experience working with SQL and relational databases.
* Familiarity with NoSQL databases and large datasets.
* Familiarity with GenAI frameworks including:
* LangChain
* LangGraph
* Hugging Face
* OpenAI APIs
* Anthropic APIs
* Understanding of:
* Prompt Engineering
* Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG)
* AI Application Development
* Understanding of cloud computing concepts.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.
* Curiosity and passion for learning emerging technologies.

Desired Qualifications \& Skills

* Exposure to AWS Data \& AI services such as SageMaker, Bedrock, Glue, Athena, or Redshift.
* Familiarity with Spark, Kafka, Snowflake, or similar data platforms.
* Exposure to MLOps concepts and tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, or SageMaker Pipelines.
* Participation in:
* Hackathons
* Kaggle Competitions
* Research Projects
* Open Source Contributions
* AWS AI Practitioner, AWS Machine Learning Engineer Associate, or equivalent cloud certifications.

What We're Looking For

* Strong analytical mindset and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Passion for Data, AI, and emerging technologies.
* Curiosity to experiment and learn continuously.
* Strong ownership and execution mindset.
* Ability to work effectively in collaborative environments.
* Good communication and stakeholder interaction skills.
* Desire to build expertise in Data Engineering, Machine Learning, GenAI, and MLOps.

What Success Looks Like

* Successfully contributes to customer and internal Data \& AI projects.
* Demonstrates strong growth in machine learning, data engineering, and AI engineering skills.
* Builds proficiency in AWS Data \& AI services.
* Effectively develops and supports AI\-powered solutions.
* Contributes reusable assets, accelerators, and best practices.
* Demonstrates learning agility and readiness for more advanced technical responsibilities.
* Progresses toward becoming a Data \& AI Engineer within the organization.

Why Join Comprinno

* Be part of a fast\-growing Data Analytics \& AI practice within one of the leading AWS partners in APJ.
* Work on cutting\-edge AI, GenAI, Agentic AI, and cloud\-native solutions.
* Gain hands\-on experience across Data Engineering, Machine Learning, MLOps, and Generative AI.
* Learn directly from AWS\-certified architects, AI practitioners, and technology leaders.
* Accelerate your growth through continuous learning, AWS certifications, and mentorship programs.
* Contribute to innovative products such as Tevico and future AI\-powered platforms.
* Join a collaborative culture that values ownership, innovation, learning, and excellence.
* Build a strong foundation for a long\-term career in Data \& AI.

Pay: Up to ₹700,000\.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* What is your CGPA score?
* In which year did you complete your graduation, and in which stream?
* How soon can you join us?
* Do you have any previous experience in Data Engineering? If yes, how many years or months?
* What is your current CTC?

Work Location: In person

title: Implementation Architect
description:
**Implementation Architect**


**Location: Bengaluru/Coimbatore**


**About AppViewX:**



AppViewX is the only machine and agent identity security company built for the AI and quantum era, bringing together discovery, automation, control, and intelligence. The AVX Platform helps enterprises reduce risk by providing complete visibility and governance over every machine and AI agent identity, automating their lifecycle, controlling their access, and proving compliance at the speed business demands. Trusted by global enterprises across financial services, healthcare, and technology, AppViewX is recognized as a leader in the IDC 2026 MarketScape for Certificate Lifecycle Management and KuppingerCole's 2025 Non\-Human Identity Management Leadership Compass. For more information, users can visit appviewx.com.


**Our Values**



Our values define how we work, make decisions, and deliver for our customers and each other. Some reflect strengths deeply engrained in how we work. Others represent the standards we are committed to building together.


* **We Do What We Say:** We own our commitments, communicate honestly about progress, and measure success by results, not activity.
* **We Are Trusted Experts:** We continuously build our expertise, offer candid guidance, and focus on the outcomes our customers and colleagues need.
* **We Raise the Bar:** We stay curious, challenge the status quo, take smart risks, and turn better ideas into meaningful results.
* **We Win Together:** We share information, debate openly, commit together, and recognize that our success is connected to the success of our customers and teammates.


If these values reflect how you want to work and contribute, you will find an opportunity to make a meaningful impact at AppViewX.


**What will you be responsible for?**



Customer Success Implementation Architects play a key role in driving Customer onboarding, Solutioning and ongoing adoption and usage of AppViewX product. You will lead the implementation of AppViewX solutions for automating customer IT Network infrastructure and Public Key Infrastructure. You will combine your deep technical knowledge with an understanding of customer business objectives /challenges help customers maximize the value of AppViewX products. You will work in the Customer Success team looking at opportunities to automate service offerings around different AppViewX products, tools and processes.


**Onboarding**


* Working with our Customer Success Managers and Customer Success Design Architects, implement AppViewX technology to solve specific business challenges for our new customers
* Address customer objectives/success criteria with in\-depth technical attention to help customer Go\-live quickly.


**Adoption and Value Quantification**


* Working with our Customer Success Managers and Customer Success Design Architects, implement additional AppViewX technology to solve specific business challenges for our new customers
* Act as a trusted technical advisor by assisting customers navigate technical challenges throughout the implementation process.
* Identify new use cases as part of account growth/renewal strategy


**Customer Experience/Engagement**


* Use your experiences working with customers to provide feedback to the rest of the AppViewX organization on how we can improve the customer experience, speed time\-to\-value, and create greater benefits for our customers
* Use your experience to look at opportunities to automate, develop tools that aid your team to reduce man hours.
* Contribute to Customer Business Reviews highlighting potential areas of improvements.


 **Roadmap Planning**


* Partner closely with other cross\-functional team members (e.g., sales, product management, support, services, delivery) to translate business needs and product requirements into new solutions
* Work closely with our Product and Engineering teams to prioritize product enhancements and long term roadmap based on customer/industry priorities.


**What do we require?**


* Minimum 5 years' experience working in a technical implementation role
* Open to work in US Shift
* Minimum 3 years' experience working in customer\-facing technical roles (such as Customer Success Engineer, Solution Engineer, Professional Services Engineer, Technical Support Engineer, Subject Matter Expert), preferably in a post\-sales capacity, for a SaaS company with enterprise software products
* Love of programming, solid coding skills in one or more of the following languages: Python, JavaScript, Java.
* Experience with web service development and using RESTful APIs
* Understanding of configuration management tools such as Chef/Puppet/Vagrant/Ansible/Salt preferred
* Experience with building Jenkins/automated test frameworks preferred
* Domain knowledge on **PKI**, DNS, Active Directory,cloud, ADCS, CRL, OCSP, and associated cryptographic standards
* + Experience with Certificate Life Cycle management/operations
	+ Experience with PKI implementation processes
	+ Experience with PKI integrations, MS Intune, SCEP, other enrollment practices
* Hands on experience with:
* + Kubernetes
	+ Linux / Windows server management
	+ Apache, IIS \- application expertise
* CISSP / CISM / CISA is preferred
* Excellent organization, troubleshooting, problem solving, deployment and multitasking skills with ability to learn new technology at a fast pace
* Worked and interacted with F500 organizations
* Exceptional communication skills, both oral and written, coupled with excellent listening skills


**Why AppViewX?**



AppViewX caters to a wide range of customers from Fortune 1000 companies, including six of the top ten global commercial banks, five of the top ten global media companies, and five of the top ten managed healthcare providers. Over the years, we grew our diverse team, perfected our automation platform, and expanded our global footprint to India, North America, United Kingdom, and Australia. Today, we are headquartered in New York City and have come a long way by optimizing opportunities to create lasting relationships with enterprises, gaining unshakable customer trust along the way.



AppViewX is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. It is AppViewX's policy to afford equal employment opportunities to all employees regardless of race, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, citizenship status, gender, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military or veteran status, pregnancy, disability, genetic information, arrest record, or other protected class under state, federal, or local law.

title: AI Engineer
description:
Job Description – AI Engineer (Fresher to 1 Year Experience)

**Position:** AI Engineer  
**Experience:** Fresher – 1 Year  
**Location:** Coimbatore

Job Summary

We are looking for a passionate AI Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate should have a strong interest in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, NLP, and Large Language Models (LLMs). This role provides an excellent opportunity to work on innovative AI solutions and gain hands\-on experience with modern AI technologies.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and implement AI and Machine Learning models.
* Assist in building NLP and LLM\-based applications.
* Collect, clean, and preprocess data for model training.
* Evaluate, test, and optimize AI models for performance and accuracy.
* Work with development teams to integrate AI solutions into applications.
* Research and explore new AI technologies and frameworks.
* Create technical documentation and reports.
* Troubleshoot and improve existing AI systems.

Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of **Python**.
* Basic understanding of **Machine Learning** and **Deep Learning** concepts.
* Knowledge of **Natural Language Processing (NLP)**.
* Familiarity with **Large Language Models (LLMs)** and Generative AI.
* Experience with **TensorFlow**, PyTorch, or similar frameworks.
* Understanding of data structures and algorithms.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong communication and teamwork abilities.

Preferred Skills

* Experience with AI/ML projects or internships.
* Knowledge of prompt engineering and AI model fine\-tuning.
* Familiarity with Git and version control systems.
* Understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS is an added advantage.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹17,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
